steps.name: Save an itinerary
steps.do: Build and **Finish** an itinerary with some animals.

steps.name: Backdate visit day
steps.do: In a terminal at the repo root, run `npm run backdate:itinerary`.
steps.expect: Terminal prints that the itinerary date was backdated to yesterday.

steps.name: Trigger past-date recovery
steps.expect: **Itinerary Date Has Passed** appears with **Clear** and **Choose New Date**.

steps.name: Choose new date
steps.do: Click **Choose New Date**, pick an allowed visit date, then **Finish**.
steps.expect: **Choose a New Visit Date** runs; itinerary saves for the new date.

steps.name: Removed-items popup
steps.do: If **Itinerary Updated** (or similar) appears, review animals added/removed, talks unavailable, times adjusted, etc.
steps.expect: Popup sections match changes, or no update popup if nothing changed.

steps.name: Alternate clear path
steps.do: Save another itinerary, run `npm run backdate:itinerary` again, hard-refresh **Itinerary**, then click **Clear**.

steps.name: Coherent result
steps.do: Inspect itinerary after accepting recovery (from the choose-new-date path).
steps.expect: Itinerary date and scheduled items match the recovered day.
